_comment: Which layer-A fixtures the Rust engine renders. Every fixture must appear here or in gaps; layerA/native-ready.unit.ts enforces that, so a new fixture cannot be silently skipped.

gaps.implicit-dollar-call: calls a JS-only fn (transform$) with no native$ declaration — unimplementable natively, as the census records
gaps.imported-callback: passes an imported JS function value as a callback; nothing native to call without a native$ declaration
gaps.plugin-callback: its compute() has no native$ declaration; the fixture covers the JS side of callback wire forms
gaps.component-signal-identity: a task writes a signal already rendered into an attribute; the JS engine emits a _qwikB patch script, which the native engine does not implement
gaps.computed-task: registers roots in a different order than the JS engine (same values, shifted indices, so QRL capture deltas differ)
gaps.deferred-collection: a collection over a deferred source serializes a different root set than the JS engine (13 roots vs 8); HTML matches
gaps.visible-task-static: registers the visible task's captured signal at a different root index than the JS engine, shifting the QRL capture deltas
